name: @intent-wallet/sdk
description: The official TypeScript SDK for the Intent Wallet API — a zero-dependency, framework-agnostic typed client for the /v1 surface (plan → authorize → execute + portfolio + status). Mirrors the wire exactly (money is decimal strings, never bigint), surfaces RFC 9457 problem+json as a typed ApiError, and injects its HTTP transport so it runs and tests in any runtime with no network. Signing stays server-side (the runtime's device-signer seam) — the SDK never holds keys. A boring functional core with a thin fluent client on top.
